en.text: In the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds—Azariah the son of Jeroham, Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, Azariah the son of Obed, Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri—into a covenant with him.

zhSimplified.text: 第七年，耶何耶大奋勇自强，将百夫长耶罗罕的儿子亚撒利雅，约哈难的儿子以实玛利，俄备得的儿子亚撒利雅，亚大雅的儿子玛西雅，细基利的儿子以利沙法召来，与他们立约。

zhTraditional.text: 第七年，耶何耶大奮勇自強，將百夫長耶羅罕的兒子亞撒利雅，約哈難的兒子以實瑪利，俄備得的兒子亞撒利雅，亞大雅的兒子瑪西雅，細基利的兒子以利沙法召來，與他們立約。

en.text: They went around in Judah and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the heads of fathers’ households of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 他们走遍犹大，从犹大各城里招聚利未人和以色列的众族长到耶路撒冷来。

zhTraditional.text: 他們走遍猶大，從猶大各城裏招聚利未人和以色列的眾族長到耶路撒冷來。

en.text: All the assembly made a covenant with the king in God’s house. Jehoiada said to them, “Behold, the king’s son must reign, as the LORD has spoken concerning the sons of David.

zhSimplified.text: 会众在 神殿里与王立约。耶何耶大对他们说：「看哪，王的儿子必当作王，正如耶和华指着大卫子孙所应许的话」；

zhTraditional.text: 會眾在上帝殿裏與王立約。耶何耶大對他們說：「看哪，王的兒子必當作王，正如耶和華指着大衛子孫所應許的話」；

en.text: This is the thing that you must do: a third part of you, who come in on the Sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be gatekeepers of the thresholds.

zhSimplified.text: 又说：「你们当这样行：祭司和利未人凡安息日进班的，三分之一要把守各门，

zhTraditional.text: 又說：「你們當這樣行：祭司和利未人凡安息日進班的，三分之一要把守各門，

en.text: A third part shall be at the king’s house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation. All the people will be in the courts of the LORD’s house.

zhSimplified.text: 三分之一要在王宫，三分之一要在基址门；众百姓要在耶和华殿的院内。

zhTraditional.text: 三分之一要在王宮，三分之一要在基址門；眾百姓要在耶和華殿的院內。

en.text: But let no one come into the LORD’s house except the priests and those who minister of the Levites. They shall come in, for they are holy, but all the people shall follow the LORD’s instructions.

zhSimplified.text: 除了祭司和供职的利未人之外，不准别人进耶和华的殿；惟独他们可以进去，因为他们圣洁。众百姓要遵守耶和华所吩咐的。

zhTraditional.text: 除了祭司和供職的利未人之外，不准別人進耶和華的殿；惟獨他們可以進去，因為他們聖潔。眾百姓要遵守耶和華所吩咐的。

en.text: The Levites shall surround the king, every man with his weapons in his hand. Whoever comes into the house, let him be slain. Be with the king when he comes in and when he goes out.”

zhSimplified.text: 利未人要手中各拿兵器，四围护卫王；凡擅入殿宇的，必当治死。王出入的时候，你们当跟随他。」

zhTraditional.text: 利未人要手中各拿兵器，四圍護衛王；凡擅入殿宇的，必當治死。王出入的時候，你們當跟隨他。」

en.text: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded. They each took his men, those who were to come in on the Sabbath, with those who were to go out on the Sabbath, for Jehoiada the priest didn’t dismiss the shift.

zhSimplified.text: 利未人和犹大众人都照着祭司耶何耶大一切所吩咐的去行，各带所管安息日进班出班的人来，因为祭司耶何耶大不许他们下班。

zhTraditional.text: 利未人和猶大眾人都照着祭司耶何耶大一切所吩咐的去行，各帶所管安息日進班出班的人來，因為祭司耶何耶大不許他們下班。

en.text: Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds the spears, bucklers, and shields that had been king David’s, which were in God’s house.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司耶何耶大便将 神殿里所藏大卫王的枪、盾牌、挡牌交给百夫长，

zhTraditional.text: 祭司耶何耶大便將上帝殿裏所藏大衛王的槍、盾牌、擋牌交給百夫長，

en.text: He set all the people, every man with his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, near the altar and the house, around the king.

zhSimplified.text: 又分派众民手中各拿兵器，在坛和殿那里，从殿右直到殿左，站在王子的四围；

zhTraditional.text: 又分派眾民手中各拿兵器，在壇和殿那裏，從殿右直到殿左，站在王子的四圍；

en.text: Then they brought out the king’s son, put the crown on him, gave him the covenant, and made him king. Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and they said, “Long live the king!”

zhSimplified.text: 于是领王子出来，给他戴上冠冕，将律法书交给他，立他作王。耶何耶大和众子膏他，众人说：「愿王万岁！」

zhTraditional.text: 於是領王子出來，給他戴上冠冕，將律法書交給他，立他作王。耶何耶大和眾子膏他，眾人說：「願王萬歲！」

en.text: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the LORD’s house.

zhSimplified.text: 亚她利雅听见民奔走赞美王的声音，就到民那里，进耶和华的殿，

zhTraditional.text: 亞她利雅聽見民奔走讚美王的聲音，就到民那裏，進耶和華的殿，

en.text: Then she looked, and behold, the king stood by his pillar at the entrance, with the captains and the trumpeters by the king. All the people of the land rejoiced and blew trumpets. The singers also played musical instruments, and led the singing of praise. Then Athaliah tore her clothes, and said, “Treason! treason!”

zhSimplified.text: 看见王站在殿门的柱旁，百夫长和吹号的人侍立在王左右，国民都欢乐吹号，又有歌唱的，用各样的乐器领人歌唱赞美；亚她利雅就撕裂衣服，喊叫说：「反了！反了！」

zhTraditional.text: 看見王站在殿門的柱旁，百夫長和吹號的人侍立在王左右，國民都歡樂吹號，又有歌唱的，用各樣的樂器領人歌唱讚美；亞她利雅就撕裂衣服，喊叫說：「反了！反了！」

en.text: Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, “Bring her out between the ranks; and whoever follows her, let him be slain with the sword.” For the priest said, “Don’t kill her in the LORD’s house.”

zhSimplified.text: 祭司耶何耶大带管辖军兵的百夫长出来，吩咐他们说：「将她赶到班外，凡跟随她的必用刀杀死！」因为祭司说：「不可在耶和华殿里杀她。」

zhTraditional.text: 祭司耶何耶大帶管轄軍兵的百夫長出來，吩咐他們說：「將她趕到班外，凡跟隨她的必用刀殺死！」因為祭司說：「不可在耶和華殿裏殺她。」

en.text: So they made way for her. She went to the entrance of the horse gate to the king’s house; and they killed her there.

zhSimplified.text: 众兵就闪开，让她去；她走到王宫的马门，便在那里把她杀了。 （王下11·17—20）

zhTraditional.text: 眾兵就閃開，讓她去；她走到王宮的馬門，便在那裏把她殺了。 （王下11‧17－20）

en.text: Jehoiada made a covenant between himself, all the people, and the king, that they should be the LORD’s people.

zhSimplified.text: 耶何耶大与众民和王立约，都要作耶和华的民。

zhTraditional.text: 耶何耶大與眾民和王立約，都要作耶和華的民。

en.text: All the people went to the house of Baal, broke it down, broke his altars and his images in pieces, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

zhSimplified.text: 于是众民都到巴力庙，拆毁了庙，打碎坛和像，又在坛前将巴力的祭司玛坦杀了。

zhTraditional.text: 於是眾民都到巴力廟，拆毀了廟，打碎壇和像，又在壇前將巴力的祭司瑪坦殺了。

en.text: Jehoiada appointed the officers of the LORD’s house under the hand of the Levitical priests, whom David had distributed in the LORD’s house, to offer the burnt offerings of the LORD, as it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as David had ordered.

zhSimplified.text: 耶何耶大派官看守耶和华的殿，是在祭司利未人手下。这祭司利未人是大卫分派在耶和华殿中、照摩西律法上所写的，给耶和华献燔祭，又按大卫所定的例，欢乐歌唱；

zhTraditional.text: 耶何耶大派官看守耶和華的殿，是在祭司利未人手下。這祭司利未人是大衛分派在耶和華殿中、照摩西律法上所寫的，給耶和華獻燔祭，又按大衛所定的例，歡樂歌唱；

en.text: He set the gatekeepers at the gates of the LORD’s house, that no one who was unclean in anything should enter in.

zhSimplified.text: 且设立守门的把守耶和华殿的各门，无论为何事，不洁净的人都不准进去。

zhTraditional.text: 且設立守門的把守耶和華殿的各門，無論為何事，不潔淨的人都不准進去。

en.text: He took the captains of hundreds, the nobles, the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought the king down from the LORD’s house. They came through the upper gate to the king’s house, and set the king on the throne of the kingdom.

zhSimplified.text: 又率领百夫长和贵胄，与民间的官长，并国中的众民，请王从耶和华殿下来，由上门进入王宫，立王坐在国位上。

zhTraditional.text: 又率領百夫長和貴冑，與民間的官長，並國中的眾民，請王從耶和華殿下來，由上門進入王宮，立王坐在國位上。

en.text: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword.

zhSimplified.text: 国民都欢乐，合城都安静。众人已将亚她利雅用刀杀了。

zhTraditional.text: 國民都歡樂，合城都安靜。眾人已將亞她利雅用刀殺了。
